title: The Morning Build for November 12, 2026: Databricks' Genie in the C-suite, Nvidia's CEO Under Fire, TSMC's $1B AI Bets, and DeepMind's Signal Proof
intro: Today’s stories center on how AI is moving from engineering experiments into governance, financing, and formal assurance: Databricks expanded its Genie agent for long-running, unsupervised business tasks; Nvidia’s board and Washington scrutiny put Jensen Huang’s role in question; TSMC approved a $1 billion investment split between OpenAI and Anthropic; and DeepMind used AlphaProof Code to formally verify parts of the Signal protocol.
meta_description: Databricks expands its Genie agent; Nvidia faces board and congressional scrutiny of CEO Jensen Huang; TSMC approved $1B for OpenAI and Anthropic; DeepMind formal-verified Signal.

stories.headline: Databricks updates Genie agent for multistep, long-running unsupervised business tasks
stories.what_happened: Databricks unveiled an updated Genie that executes multistep jobs requiring extended work by using an internal ontology that pulls context from data stored on the Databricks platform. CEO Ali Ghodsi demonstrated Genie running on real internal use cases, including survey analysis, sales-pitch summarization, and interview prep, and Databricks said Unity Gateway can cap usage and swap in cheaper open-weight models to control costs.
stories.why_it_matters: Engineers and platform teams get an agent designed to operate unsupervised across long-running, multi-step business workflows with platform-aware context coming from a Databricks-built ontology; cost controls via Unity Gateway let operators set usage limits and model substitution policies.
stories.outlook: Databricks’ forthcoming product documentation and demos for Genie and Unity Gateway will show the specific usage-limit and model-substitution controls available to customers.

stories.headline: Nvidia’s board reportedly preparing to remove CEO Jensen Huang amid probes and congressional attention
stories.what_happened: Reports say Nvidia’s stock dropped as the board prepared steps that could oust Jensen Huang following revelations about an extramarital affair and related allegations; coverage notes a pending congressional call for Huang to answer questions tied to an alleged Chinese spy affair.
stories.why_it_matters: A board transition at Nvidia would alter leadership at the company that supplies the majority of AI-training GPUs and could force immediate operational and customer-facing continuity decisions, while congressional scrutiny introduces regulatory and public-accountability pressure.
stories.outlook: A scheduled congressional call for Jensen Huang, reported in coverage, is the next public milestone to watch for timing and content of official testimony.

stories.headline: TSMC board approves up to $1 billion investment split for OpenAI preferred stock and Anthropic shares
stories.what_happened: TSMC’s board approved up to $500 million to buy OpenAI preferred stock reserved for large investors and up to $500 million to purchase Anthropic common shares at Anthropic’s expected IPO price, giving the foundry direct financial stakes in two leading AI developers.
stories.why_it_matters: A chip manufacturer taking equity positions in major AI model developers creates tighter capital links between semiconductor supply and AI software demand, which affects how engineers and procurement teams interpret vendor incentives and supply-side demand signals for data-center chips.
stories.outlook: Anthropic’s expected IPO price, referenced by TSMC’s approval to buy common shares at that price, is the next market milestone that will finalize the Anthropic portion of the investment.

stories.headline: DeepMind used AlphaProof Code to formally verify key parts of the Signal protocol and released the specification and proof
stories.what_happened: Google DeepMind applied an agentic AI framework called AlphaProof Code to formally verify several cryptographic guarantees in portions of the Signal protocol in a four-week proof-of-concept; researchers released the specification and proof and reported no new vulnerabilities in the analyzed parts, and AlphaProof Code correctly flagged older known vulnerabilities in prior Signal versions.
stories.why_it_matters: This demonstrates AI-assisted formal verification can produce machine-checked specifications and proofs for real-world cryptographic protocol components far faster than traditional manual efforts, giving security and engineering teams a potential accelerator for parts of high-assurance code verification.
stories.outlook: The public release of the specification and proof from DeepMind’s Signal analysis is the immediate artifact researchers and tool builders can inspect to assess AlphaProof Code’s methods and limitations.

narration_script: Databricks updated its Genie agent to run multistep, long-running tasks using an ontology that extracts context from data on the Databricks platform. CEO Ali Ghodsi demonstrated real internal uses including survey analysis, sales-pitch summarization, and interview preparation. Databricks also says Unity Gateway can enforce usage limits and swap in cheaper open-weight models to control agent cost. The next public artifacts to check will be Databricks’ product documentation and demos showing the specific Unity Gateway controls. Reports this week put Nvidia’s board under pressure to remove CEO Jensen Huang after revelations about an extramarital affair and related allegations, and coverage says Congress plans to call Huang to answer questions connected to an alleged Chinese spy affair. A congressional call is the immediate public milestone that will clarify the timing and scope of official testimony. TSMC’s board approved up to one billion dollars in investments split between OpenAI and Anthropic: up to five hundred million for OpenAI preferred stock allocated to large investors and up to five hundred million to buy Anthropic common shares at Anthropic’s expected IPO price. That move binds a major foundry financially to leading model developers, and Anthropic’s IPO pricing is the next market event that will complete the Anthropic allocation. Finally, Google DeepMind used an agentic framework called AlphaProof Code to formally verify key parts of the Signal protocol in a four-week proof-of-concept. Researchers released the specification and proof, and the tool correctly surfaced older, fixed vulnerabilities in past versions. The released specification and proof are now available for engineers and verification researchers to inspect and reproduce DeepMind’s results.
